_about: Every shipped code LINE that holds a PowerShell program name, by fingerprint (the first 16 hex digits of the sha256 of the trimmed line; the text beside it is only a reminder). names_only: lines that hold the name without starting it (they classify a command an engine proposes, or label the owner's shell). user_terminal: the ONE place Murage opens PowerShell, the person's own Open terminal when Windows Terminal is missing (MurageMain, nops round 3: the commands Murage shows for pasting on Windows are PowerShell, so the fallback window is PowerShell, never cmd). open_spawns: Murage-own code that still starts PowerShell; EMPTY for 1.0.3 (MurageMain, no deferral) and the guard keeps it so. A changed or new line fails the guard until it is reviewed here; any launch of PowerShell fails wherever it is, unless it is the user_terminal line (server/no-powershell-spawn.test.ts). Murage must not start PowerShell by itself on Windows (murage-releases #1: an antivirus notice and a visible start; the packaged smoke step 5 fails on any app-spawned powershell.exe).
